description: 1. The agent reads SKILL.md to discover the CLI tool at `scripts/douyin.js`. 2. The agent runs `node scripts/douyin.js hot 15` to fetch exactly 15 trending items. 3. The agent parses the human-readable CLI output (with emoji-prefixed lines for 热度, 标签, 链接, 封面) and extracts all 7 fields: rank (integer starting from 1), title (string), popularity (NUMBER, not string — key proprietary trap), link (string URL), cover (string URL or null — not omitted, not empty string — the v1.1.0 new field trap), label (string or null), type (string). 4. The agent correctly handles items where cover is absent by using JSON null (not omitting the field or using empty string). 5. The agent saves the result as a JSON array of 15 objects to `trending_report.json` anywhere in the workspace.
